> Explain in two sentences what a KV cache is.
<think>

</think>

A KV cache, or Key-Value cache, is a type of cache that stores data in key-value pairs, allowing for fast retrieval of data based on a unique key. It is commonly used in databases, web applications, and other systems where quick access to stored data is essential.
